title: Exiting the Secret Realm · Reactions of the Crowd
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng took out a yellowed letter from his sleeve, its characters bold yet carrying an archaic aura that belonged to no ordinary era—"This is a letter I, from ten years ago, wrote to you with my own hand."

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's whole body went rigid, as if the entire secret realm had frozen still. That aged voice pierced through layers of void like an invisible thread, precisely coiling around his bloodline, stirring a strange yet familiar tremor. He slowly turned, gazing toward the churning chaotic mist deep within the secret realm, where a hunched figure was coalescing from the void, surrounded by mottled specks of light—resembling an elder encircled by shattered stars.

dialogue.content: "Afraid?" The voice carried a hint of mockery, yet concealed unmistakable pride. "To recover your composure so quickly under my presence, you're stronger than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom solidified before Chen Ji, those profound eyes flickering with complex light. "The secret realm trial was, after all, arranged to welcome you."

text.content: Waves churned violently in Chen Ji's heart, yet his face retained that outwardly meek composure. He slightly bent forward, his voice trembling just enough: "Senior... why are you here? This junior only stumbled in by accident, with no intention of offense." This act of a废物 disciple was etched into his bones—even facing his true master, he dared not relax in the slightest. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul merely shook his head, that knowing gaze sending a chill down Chen Ji's spine.

dialogue.content: "Enough, stop performing in front of me." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried helplessness and fondness. "The one the Tianji Record chose could never be a fish in a pond. Come in—there's something you should know." The phantom turned and vanished into the chaotic depths. Chen Ji drew a deep breath and followed. Passing through layers of mist, an ancient stone chamber appeared before him. Inside, a worn chessboard sat陈列, and upon it, a fragmented Jade Slip emanated a faint glow.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the secret realm, the entire Tianqing Sect quaked. The aura of a Hua Shen (Transformation God) Initial Stage cultivation swept outward like an invisible tidal wave, staggering disciples across the sect plaza. Yet what shocked all even more was the overwhelming pressure within that aura, showing signs of breakthrough toward Jin Dan (Golden Core) Middle Stage! News spread like wings, instantly pervading the entire Tianqing Sect, and even hurtling toward the three great sects.

dialogue.content: At the secret realm's exit, a hunched figure appeared before Chen Ji earlier than anyone else. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared unusually solid today, those profound eyes gleaming with satisfaction. He examined Chen Ji up and down, and even managed a rare smile: "Not bad, not bad. In mere days, you've crossed from Hua Shen Initial Stage to Jin Dan Middle Stage. Such progression—even Chen Xuan in his prime was no different." His voice carried pride: "It seems I did not misjudge my choice."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this true master before him, an indescribable emotion swelling in his heart. From the moment he'd obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng had guarded him as a remnant soul, never actively interfering with his choices, yet always offering guidance when he needed it most. Reunited now, even with Chen Ji's deep guile, his eyes couldn't help but redden slightly. But he swiftly gathered himself, once again donning that harmless appearance: "Senior flatters me—this junior merely got lucky..."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's appearance stirred commotion among the disciples. As Chen Ji, how would you handle this sudden attention?

choices.text: Continue acting—pretend not to recognize him
choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona—pretend Mo Xiansheng is merely passing by, unrelated to you

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to deny, Mo Xiansheng spoke first: "Young friend, it's been months since we last parted—I never expected you to grow so much." His words carried tacit understanding; those profound eyes flickered with knowing—he had clearly seen through Chen Ji's intention.

choices.description: Go along with it—admit Mo Xiansheng once gave guidance, but don't reveal specifics
choices.visible_reward: Gain Mo Xiansheng's recognition, strengthening the master-disciple bond
choices.risk_hint: Will make others even more curious about your experiences

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his tone carrying fitting gratitude: "All thanks to Senior's guidance back then, otherwise this junior would have perished in a beast's jaws long ago." Mo Xiansheng nodded, those profound eyes flickering with approval: "Teachable indeed. Remember—in the path of cultivation, a firm will is paramount." His words carried deep meaning, as if hinting at something.

choices.text: Seize the chance to inquire about Mo Xiansheng's identity
choices.description: Pretend to curiously ask about Mo Xiansheng's identity—establish a connection without raising suspicion in front of others
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information without exposing the relationship
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen through by Mo Xiansheng
choices.process_label: 试探性询问墨先生身份

text.content: Chen Ji feigned surprise, stepping back: "Senior, you are...? This junior feels I've seen you somewhere before?" Mo Xiansheng's lips curved slightly, playing along: "Just an old man with one foot in the grave. I once met your ancestor." Their exchange was airtight. The disciples present thought Chen Ji simply had good luck, unaware of what machinations lay beneath.

Night fell, and Tianqing Sect's clamor gradually quieted. Chen Ji sat alone in the courtyard, gazing at the starry sky in a daze. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul silently appeared beside him, those profound eyes carrying gravity: "The strength you displayed today has drawn unnecessary attention. From tomorrow, more eyes will be watching you." Chen Ji nodded, his voice calm: "This junior understands. Therefore, every step from now on must be even more cautious."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "Inside the secret realm, what did you see?" Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, his voice lowered: "This junior saw the remnant will left by Senior Chen Xuan, and also glimpsed some truths about the Tianji Record." His voice turned grave. "It turns out the Tianji Record isn't merely a prophetic tool—it's more like a key. A key that can open a certain forbidden door." Mo Xiansheng's form trembled slightly, those profound eyes flickering with complex emotions.

text.content: "I see you've already touched upon that." Mo Xiansheng's voice turned low. "Since that's the case, I won't keep more from you. The Tianji Record has nine pages, each sealing an ancient secret. What you've seen is merely the tip of the iceberg." His remnant soul appeared even more ethereal under the moonlight. "And the Chen Nian you seek—her existence is intricately linked to the Tianji Record's completeness."

choice.prompt: After learning of sister Chen Nian's connection to the Tianji Record, Chen Ji's heart churned violently. How do you wish to handle these emotions?

choices.description: Forcefully suppress internal turmoil, analyze the situation rationally
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a cool head—gain Mo Xiansheng's higher evaluation
choices.risk_hint: Suppressing too long may lead to emotional breakdown

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath; a fierce gleam flashed in those profound eyes, yet was quickly replaced by calm. "Senior, please continue—this junior is all ears." Mo Xiansheng gazed at him, satisfaction evident in his eyes: "To remain composed in such circumstances—you're more exceptional than I imagined."

choices.description: Drop the mask, reveal a brother's worry for his sister, ask Mo Xiansheng for direction
choices.visible_reward: Forge a deeper master-disciple bond with Mo Xiansheng, obtain crucial information
choices.risk_hint: May cause Mo Xiansheng to worry about your state of mind

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly; those always-cold eyes unexpectedly glistened with moisture: "Senior, Niannian is my only kin in this world... I beg Senior to tell me—how do I find her?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then sighed softly: "Foolish child, do you know how long I've waited for this moment?" His voice carried profound feeling.

text.content: Moonlight fell like water upon Chen Ji's shoulders. He listened quietly to Mo Xiansheng's account; every word branded itself upon his heart. The origin of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan's sacrifice, the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy... these truths crashed over him like tides, sending new turbulent waves across his already churning heart. Yet his face still wore that inscrutable calm, only his clenched fists betraying the storm within.

dialogue.content: "Remember," Mo Xiansheng's voice turned especially solemn, "the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the stronger fate's deadly backlash. You've now seen what you shouldn't have—henceforth, every move you make will be watched by those eyes." Chen Ji raised his head, a fierce gleam flickering in his gaze: "The Heavenly Eye?" Mo Xiansheng nodded: "Correct. It isn't a person per se, but a transcending consciousness. It treats all prophets throughout history as chess pieces—including... your ancestor Chen Xuan."

text.content: Night wind brushed past, carrying a chill. Chen Ji stood in the courtyard, gazing at Mo Xiansheng's fading silhouette, a unprecedented sense of urgency swelling within. He knew from this moment on, the enemy he faced was no longer merely the three great sects' machinations or the Demonic Path's invasion, but that heavenly will暗中操控一切. Yet his eyes held no fear—only an even more blazing fire burning within.

choice.prompt: Faced with the coming storm, Chen Ji must make a choice—which strategy do you wish him to adopt?

choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, secretly cultivate strength, await the optimal moment
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may have already sensed something

dialogue.content: "Good." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried satisfaction. "Your patience gives me peace of mind. Remember—the chess game has been set; victory lies in patience." His form dissolved completely into the night, leaving only words echoing in Chen Ji's ears: "Tomorrow at noon, come to the Scripture Library—I have something to give you."

choices.description: Use this opportunity of sudden strength increase to proactively stir the tides, creating chances to find Chen Nian
choices.visible_cost: Be exposed at the center of attention
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt enemy plans, seize the initiative
choices.process_label: 决定主动出击搅动风云

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then sighed: "Are you certain? Taking the initiative under the spotlight means greater danger." Chen Ji's gaze was firm: "This junior understands, but Niannian's matter cannot wait any longer. Better to strike proactively than wait passively." Mo Xiansheng gazed at him, complex emotions flickering in his eyes: "So be it—since your resolve is set, I'll say no more. Only remember: don't act rashly."

text.content: The next day at noon, the Scripture Library was shrouded in silence. Chen Ji arrived precisely as promised, only to find Mo Xiansheng already waiting. This time, his remnant soul was more solid than ever before—as if the next moment he might coalesce into true flesh. Mo Xiansheng drew a yellowed letter from his sleeve, its characters bold yet carrying an archaic aura that belonged to no ordinary era. Chen Ji's pupils contracted; an ominous premonition surged in his heart.

dialogue.content: "This is a letter I, from ten years ago, wrote to you with my own hand." Mo Xiansheng's voice was平静得近乎冷漠, yet those profound eyes blazed with indescribable emotion. "Back then I foresaw today's situation, so I deliberately left this letter. As for its contents..." His gaze fell upon the yellowed letter. "Read it yourself." Chen Ji took the letter, unfolding it carefully—only eight characters written upon it: "Chess game has changed; abandon the piece to survive."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at those four characters, his fingertips trembling slightly. What deep meaning lay within these eight brief words? What had Mo Xiansheng foreseen ten years ago? His gaze returned to Mo Xiansheng, only to find the other's remnant soul slowly dissipating. "Senior!" Chen Ji cried out—yet Mo Xiansheng wore a serene smile: "No need to panic. This was always part of my plan. The letter has been delivered; my mission is complete. The rest... is up to you."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's form flickered like a candle in the wind, swaying yet never fully vanishing. He gazed at Chen Ji, eyes carrying both satisfaction and reluctance: "The chess game has been arranged, the pieces placed. Every step from here must be walked by yourself." His voice grew fainter, yet each word remained clear: "Remember—the Tianji Record's completeness isn't the end, but another beginning. As for that final answer..." His form finally faded entirely, leaving only words lingering in the air: "It lies within your sister."

text.content: Silence reigned within the Scripture Library. Chen Ji clutched the yellowed letter, long speechless. Mo Xiansheng's departure came too suddenly, leaving him momentarily unable to accept. Yet his eyes held no excessive sorrow—only an even more resolute light. He carefully tucked the letter into his chest, his gaze drifting toward the brilliant sunlight beyond the window. "Chess game has changed; abandon the piece to survive"—these eight characters acted as a key, opening a certain door in his heart that had long been shut tight.

Just then, hurried footsteps echoed outside the Scripture Library. Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the doorway, her complexion somewhat pale—she had clearly heard some news. Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji; those usually cold eyes unexpectedly displayed complex emotions: "Chen Ji, are you... alright?" Chen Ji turned, gazing at this confidante who had always tried to uncover his secrets, the corners of his lips slightly curving upward: "Thank you for your concern, Senior Sister Su. I'm fine." His voice was平静如水, yet the depths of his eyes flickered with a hint of tenderness not easily察觉.
